name: @vssaros/dsh-web-content-import
description: VsSaros web-content-import module for DeepSeek Harness: a single `content_import` tool that resolves a URL (platform article / video), fetches its content (HTTP + reader for static pages, yt-dlp + whisper ASR for videos, caller-fed HTML for login-walled pages), and optionally writes it into the knowledge base (库/raw/<slug>.md). 落盘契约与 IDE 侧 kbUrlScraper / web-content-import 技能逐字对齐；方案见 doc/dsh-content-import-plan.md。
